# CI-HERO-EXPR-REENTRY-LIVE-001

Authority: [#2268](https://github.com/anitaguptaoffice/sanguo-slg/issues/2268). New isolated CI implementation; no local browser retry. Review the exact QA head and frozen product combination before execution. Checkout only the independently reviewed #2267 final head `a020369eb4f58e835522934c662ab1fd3d4161e3`, tree `16fb9da5b53af34d75cae9cbbd21a8e39f1dcfed`. Its ordered parents are original source `409ad569415ea7215dc1297c2306423d0392dea4` and main `757e43a9f40d7c92ded6a536ec334de94d69ff6f`; the original source parent is `e2b60dda830d9b25f15fcfced4da4acc090a8f1c`. This is byte-identical to the reviewed four-file delta combination, not a floating ref or a new product change.

Two fresh official Ubuntu 22.04 jobs use PG17, Redis7, locked Playwright 1.49.1 sandbox Chromium, actual server DDL/two boots/seven existing DATA-002 seeds, complete main.ts/Vite client, full client tests/build and real Gateway. The sole disclosed fixture changes the real fresh owner's existing gold from 0 to 10; its row-locked before/after record proves every other wallet field/timestamp unchanged. No hero, authentication, EXP, session, deadline, result or config fixture is permitted.

The genuine starter 2004 recruits 1017. Exact wire sequence: Recruit success, explicit keyboard idle Finish rejection, Begin 1h once/cost 10, explicit early Finish rejection after real reload/login, natural-deadline Finish once/EXP 20/status 1/session removed. Unknown-state Cancel/Faster stay disabled; known future Finish stays disabled; no automatic, extra, Cancel/Faster/Upgrade command. Level 1/20 EXP is insufficient for the 100 EXP upgrade. The current acknowledged view disables Finish, but later detail reread honestly returns unknown; it is not permission to retry.

The normal starter farm accrues 120 food/hour. Read-only atomic snapshots include the durable production checkpoint's exact nanosecond time/remainder, allowing exact reconciliation of natural food versus recruit/training debits; wood/iron/stone/gold have no unexplained changes. Later normal wallet timestamps are not falsely required to remain frozen. Original PG session/hero/item invariants remain exact.

The 75-minute job limit includes setup. An internal deadline 72 minutes after the verified GitHub workflow run start conservatively includes queue/service setup and reserves cleanup/upload; the public unauthenticated run API must return the matching run ID and a valid nonfuture timestamp, otherwise setup fails; the pre-Begin guard requires the entire natural hour, original ends_at+120s grace and response margin to fit. Neither deadline extends. SQL, readiness, browser actions, screenshots, close and process termination are bounded. Browser/server/client cleanup and sanitized reports/logs/screenshots run on failure. Already stopped bootstrap cleanup is idempotent; unexpected prior exits, nonzero/signal exits, forced kills or remaining live children fail acceptance. Abrupt runner loss/hard cancellation can still prevent upload; then only GitHub job evidence exists, never a PASS. No mutation is automatically retried, including uncertain transport outcomes.

Artifacts record safe synthetic request IDs, routes/hero/payloads only for listed non-auth operations, replies/timings, scoped SQL, versions, frozen tree and screenshots at 1280×720/1600×900. Authentication payloads/tokens/credentials are excluded. Independent visual review and exact-head CI remain mandatory; a script PASS is not blanket #2267 release. Missing-session corruption, generic transport ambiguity, account/hero-switch races and successful upgrade are explicitly untested here. No deployment or historical hold release.
